{{Quote|What are you? What do you want with me?!''"<br />"''I am the darkness, the all consuming horror, the ultimate fear!|Anakin Skywalker and the dark side entity|<ref name="TOP" />}}
Sometime during his [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], a '''duel''' took place in the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|Jedi Council Chamber]] when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was confronted by a [[Unidentified dark side entity|dark side entity]] in a powerful [[Force vision/Legends|vision]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|It's just that, I ''sense'' something&hellip; a ''darkness''.|Anakin Skywalker, to Tiplee|<ref name="TOP" />}}
Sometime after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], during a lesson with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] being [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked]] by something he could not see.<ref name="TOP" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|Younglings?! But how&hellip;?! If it's me you came here for, then let them go. You leave them ''alone''!!''"<br />"''There is nothing you can do. Their fate is already sealed.|Anakin Skywalker and the dark side entity|<ref name="TOP" />}}
[[File:Unidentified_dark_side_entity_3.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The dark side entity blasts [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]]]
That night, feeling a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Skywalker left his [[Jedi Temple dormitory|dormitory]] and went to the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|Jedi Council Chamber]], where a [[Unidentified dark side entity|dark side entity]] appeared in front of him. Activating [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]], Skywalker engaged the entity in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] and inquired it on its motives. The entity then told him that he would turn to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="TOP" />

Foreshadowing [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|his future attack]] on the Jedi Temple, a group of defenseless [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]] materialized in the Jedi Council Chamber. The entity told Skywalker that he could not save them, and that their fate was already sealed. The entity then subjected him to [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. As he was losing all hope, Skywalker intuitively used [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]] to call out to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who heard his desperate plea far across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Focusing on his close friend, Skywalker filled up with energy of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] and destroyed the entity.<ref name="TOP" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I just don't understand what's gotten into him lately.''"<br />"''A powerful vision, experienced he has. In time, understand perhaps we will.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda|<ref name="TOP" />}}
Following the incident, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], warned by [[Tiplee/Legends|Tiplee]], found his apprentice in the Jedi Council Chamber. The exhausted Padawan was then taken to his room, where he fell [[Sleep/Legends|asleep]]. In the corridor, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] explained to Kenobi that Skywalker had experienced a powerful [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] and that perhaps, in [[Time/Legends|time]], they would understand it.<ref name="TOP" />
